name: pyinfra-e491958d-blind20-ots
instr:
# pyinfra behaving badly across the CLI, fact parsing and package/user operations — without a test suite

I upgraded our copy of pyinfra and a lot of things that used to work now misbehave. The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits. Below is everything I have been able to pin down by observation, grouped roughly by area.

## Running operations from the command line

Invoking a named operation directly on the command line — an inventory followed by a dotted operation name and its arguments, e.g. a shell command — no longer runs. It bails out with a complaint about the operation instead of executing it, and this happens the same way with and without the confirm flag, and whether or not JSON output is requested. In the JSON modes the same invocation should print a plan (and, with confirmation, a results block containing per-operation, totals and failed-host sections); currently neither the plan nor the results ever appear because the run never gets that far.

Passing a single JSON-encoded argument blob in place of positional arguments to an operation is also broken: the blob is no longer decoded into the positional list and keyword mapping the operation should receive.

## Fetching facts from the command line
